description: Part B lifecycle scenarios (SPEC-v2 §6.9, §7). Replay each scenario against a fresh in-memory reference store whose authoritative clock starts at start_time, whose evaluator lease is lease_seconds, and whose receipt log log_id is signed by verifier_key. Requests use the verifier-ordering input schema; the request's now is always the store clock at the step.

semantics.claim_only: preflight and claim without evaluating (an evaluator that crashed after claiming); expect disposition or error_class
semantics.publish: drain the outbox for the request's committed outcome. mode ok = reference publisher; signer_failure = the publisher fails and appends nothing (failed=true); corrupt_signature = the published receipt with one Ed25519 signature byte flipped. Expect receipt_sequence
semantics.recover: RecoverInterruptedClaim with the claim's authoritative claim time; expect stage committed (idempotent for the same body) or error_class
semantics.release: ReleaseV2Decision with the request's committed outcome and its last published receipt (none when not published, or receipt_of another request). checkpoint reference = the store checkpoint; wrong_entry = acknowledgements report a different entry hash. Expect release_status, release_reason, decision, release_time
semantics.release_forged: ReleaseV2Decision with a committed outcome that was never produced by the verifier (zero value); always rejected
semantics.set_ack_withheld: withheld=true stops the reference outbox from submitting appended entries to the checkpoint; withheld=false submits every pending entry in log order at the current clock
semantics.set_time: set the authoritative clock (it may move backward to exercise clock regression)
semantics.verifier_configuration: status keys, status policy, trust, journal setup and evidence come from each request exactly as in verifier-ordering.json
semantics.verify: VerifyProofBundleV2 against the store; expect stage, error_class, disposition; for committed, decision/decision_reason are read from the committed receipt body for the test only, and allow_horizon is the handoff value

scenarios.name: allow_published_acknowledged_released
scenarios.description: verify commits a non-actionable allow; publication and acknowledgement release it; a second release is idempotent and appends nothing

scenarios.name: release_without_receipt_is_pending
scenarios.description: a committed allow without a published receipt is pending, never released (Part A to Part B downgrade attempt)

scenarios.name: release_without_acknowledgement_is_pending_then_late_ack_releases
scenarios.description: an appended but unacknowledged receipt is pending; a late acknowledgement before every deadline releases it at the acknowledgement time

scenarios.name: late_ack_at_challenge_expiry_is_withheld
scenarios.description: an acknowledgement timestamped at the challenge expiry can never release (exclusive deadline)

scenarios.name: release_at_challenge_expiry_is_withheld
scenarios.description: release at exactly expires_at is withheld even with an earlier acknowledgement

scenarios.name: release_at_allow_horizon_is_withheld
scenarios.description: an allow whose status horizon is Now+1 is withheld when released at exactly Now+1

scenarios.name: release_before_allow_horizon
scenarios.description: the same allow released at Now, before its Now+1 horizon, is released

scenarios.name: signer_failure_then_retry
scenarios.description: a publisher (signer) failure appends nothing and release stays pending; a retry publishes and releases

scenarios.name: corrupt_receipt_signature_is_rejected
scenarios.description: a published receipt whose signature does not verify under the configured verifier key is rejected

scenarios.name: receipt_of_another_claim_is_rejected
scenarios.description: a valid receipt for a different committed claim does not bind this claim's body

scenarios.name: acknowledgement_for_another_entry_is_rejected
scenarios.description: an acknowledgement whose entry hash differs from the verified receipt is a fork signal and is rejected

scenarios.name: forged_committed_outcome_is_rejected
scenarios.description: an application cannot release a committed outcome the verifier did not produce

scenarios.name: clock_regression_at_release_is_withheld
scenarios.description: a release reading earlier than the acknowledgement time is a clock regression

scenarios.name: crash_after_claim_lease_recovery
scenarios.description: an evaluator that crashes after claiming leaves the claim in progress; recovery is refused while the lease is live, then commits evaluation_interrupted, which publishes and releases as a non-actionable indeterminate; recovery is idempotent

scenarios.name: different_proof_for_claimed_challenge_is_replay
scenarios.description: a second, different proof for an already claimed challenge is rejected before claim without disclosure and does not advance the stream

scenarios.name: stream_sequence_rules
scenarios.description: first sequence must be 1; exact retries replay without advancing; duplicates, gaps and reorders fail before claim with stream_sequence_mismatch; of two claims with the same sequence exactly one commits
